test_overview: Evaluated the Inventory module end-to-end against the 10-step test plan (68 points). The app (React SPA at /inventory, login admin/admin123) passed every step: login/navigation/Adequate seeded item; creating items with and without initial quantity (Critical status at qty 0; auto Entry/25/Manual Adjustment transaction created for initial qty 25); boundary statuses Low Stock (qty==min==100) and Critical (qty 49 < 50); editing description/threshold with status recalculation and SKU immutability (disabled field); validation rejects (empty SKU/description via required-field validation, threshold 0 via min=1, duplicate SKU with 'SKU already exists'); deletion constraints (SEED-PAPER-001 blocked 'Cannot delete item with transaction history', SEED-DELETE-OK deleted successfully); case-insensitive search; status filtering (Critical/Adequate) with correct inclusion/exclusion; sorting by quantity ascending (0,25,49,100,100) and status severity (Critical→Low Stock→Adequate). All non-fatal visual checks (distinct red/orange/green badges) also passed. No code modifications were made; verification JSON logs written for all steps. Total score: 68/68.

steps.description: test_login_and_verify_inventory_navigation: Logged in as admin/admin123; app shell has persistent sidebar nav with Inventory destination; Dashboard shown by default after login (non-fatal pass); navigated to Inventory - list displayed; SEED-PAPER-001 present with Qty 100/Min 50 and Adequate status. All checks passed.

test_create_item_without_initial_quantity: Created INV-TONER-001 (threshold 20, initial quantity left empty). Item created with quantity 0 and Critical status (0 < half of 20); Critical badge visually distinct (red). All checks passed.

test_create_item_with_initial_quantity_auto_transaction: Created INV-STAPLER-001 (threshold 10, initial qty 25) -> shows qty 25, Adequate. Transaction history (item detail page) shows auto-created Entry transaction, +25, reason 'Manual Adjustment', resulting balance 25. All checks passed.

test_stock_status_boundaries: Created INV-PENS-001 (threshold 100, qty 100) -> Low Stock (100 <= 100 AND 100 >= 50). Created INV-CLIPS-001 (threshold 100, qty 49) -> Critical (49 < 50). Three statuses visually distinguishable (green/orange/red badges). All checks passed.

test_edit_item_and_sku_immutability: Edited INV-TONER-001: description -> 'Black Toner Cartridge Compatible', threshold -> 15; saved; both updated and status recalculated (still Critical, qty 0). SKU field in edit form is disabled (not editable) and remains INV-TONER-001 after save. All checks passed.

test_validation_rules: Empty SKU rejected (required validation, form stayed open, no item created); empty Description rejected; Minimum Threshold=0 rejected; duplicate SKU INV-TONER-001 rejected with inline error 'SKU already exists'. No invalid items created; list contains only valid items.

test_deletion_constraints: Deleting SEED-PAPER-001 blocked with 'Cannot delete item with transaction history' (item still exists). SEED-DELETE-OK (qty 0, no history) deleted successfully and removed from list. All checks passed.

test_search_functionality: Search 'TONER' -> only INV-TONER-001 shown, stapler hidden. Search 'stapler' (lowercase) -> INV-STAPLER-001 matched (case-insensitive). Clearing search restored full list. All checks passed.

test_filter_by_status: Critical filter shows INV-TONER-001 and INV-CLIPS-001, hides INV-STAPLER-001/INV-PENS-001. Adequate filter shows INV-STAPLER-001 and SEED-PAPER-001, hides toner/pens. Clearing restores all. All checks passed.

test_sort_by_quantity_and_status: Quantity (lowest first) order 0->25->49->100->100 with toner first, stapler before clips, 100-qty items last. Status (critical first) places both Critical items before others, then Low Stock before Adequate (full severity ordering). All checks passed.
